lines.text: If you eat a whole bag of candy,
the sugar rushes from your gut into your blood within minutes.
Your brain gets a hit of dopamine, so it feels amazing.
But your body can't leave that much sugar in your blood,
so your pancreas pumps out insulin,
which unlocks your cells so they can soak the sugar up.
The rest gets packed into your liver, or turned into fat.
Then, because of all that insulin, your blood sugar can drop below where it started.
That's the crash that leaves you tired, shaky, and craving more candy.
